column2: [intro]
My world is made of lightness and cheer,
I prefer to talk of trifles, with a detached leer.
With a gaze that's slightly aloof,
I deliberately avoid topics that cause a rift.
I sing frivolous songs with zest,
Not bothered by issues that spark unrest.
Lightness is my guiding line,
I leave the controversies to others in time.
My lyrics aren't manifestos grand,
I prefer to entertain rather than take a stand.
I don't censor myself; it's simply my choice,
I opt for singing stories that make some noise.
